metadata.description: Claude at the table: DM a session, simulate a fight, or recap a test run for players

plugins.name: rpg-helper
plugins.description: Three D&D 5e (2014) skills over an Obsidian campaign vault: narrate-encounter runs the table with Claude as DM, simulate-encounter fights a party against monsters with nobody playing to answer who would win, and dry-run-recap turns a finished dry run into a player-facing recap for a campaign site
